name: Sausage Gravy
notes: Also adaptable to camping by mixing powdered milk and flour and seasonings in a ziploc, then adding water at camp.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: In a skillet on the stove, over medium heat, brown **½ pound breakfast sausage**.

steps.title: Whisk the milk and flour
steps.body: In a separate container, whisk together **3 cups milk** and **6 Tbsp flour**.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.body: Add to sausage, and cook on medium, stirring occasionally, until it thickens. Do not let boil.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Add salt and pepper to taste.
